Meet Sam. She's an analyst at a long short hedge fund. Her job: find the stocks the market has wrong.
Six A M. Bloomberg, headlines, futures. Before most people are awake.
Seven thirty. The portfolio manager asks one question: what's your variant view?
Nine thirty. The market opens. Her biggest long is down eight percent. On no news.
Ten. She checks the thesis again. Nothing has changed. She holds.
Noon. An expert call with a former employee of the company.
Two P M. Channel checks, and a model with way too many tabs.
Four P M. The market closes. The stock came all the way back.
Seven P M. Earnings tonight. The portfolio manager wants a call at six A M.
